About this role:
The Director of Engineering, New Products is a senior technical leadership role that owns the system design vision for a new business line. This person sets the architecture, translates business requirements into sound technical decisions, and pulls the pieces and teams together around one direction. They provide technical leadership to a contractor team of three from day one, with potential for 1-2 additional small teams over time, and work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and business leaders. The role is hands-on and scales through process, automation, and AI-assisted development rather than headcount. It is internally facing and does not include external, commercial, or partner-facing work.
This role requires balancing strategic thinking with pragmatic execution — helping teams solve complex challenges while maintaining a strong focus on quality, performance, on-time delivery, and long-term maintainability. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable operating at a systems architecture level and rolling up their sleeves to move a critical initiative forward. They bring a builder's mindset, a bias toward action, and the interpersonal skills to work effectively across internal teams and stakeholders alike. They use AI coding agents such as Claude Code every day and look to scale through the process before adding people.

lists.content:
• Launch new platform capabilities from scratch, from design through production on committed timelines
  • Design and evolve integrations with dozens of third-party systems, including pharmaceutical manufacturers and clinic systems, with reliability and observability built in
  • Architect the data pipelines, APIs, and services that move data between veterinary clinics, pet owners, drug manufacturers, and industry partners
  • Oversee end-to-end technical execution of key initiatives, managing timelines, dependencies, and cross-team coordination
  • Run architecture reviews and hands-on guidance sessions for complex initiatives spanning multiple teams and systems
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks in third-party integrations, data quality, scalability, and performance before they reach customers or partners
  • Contribute to product roadmap planning and prioritization
  • Evaluate emerging technologies in integrations, data platforms, APIs, and distributed systems to inform the technical roadmap

• 10+ years of software engineering, including 3+ years at a Staff or Principal level or equivalent technical leadership
  • Built or launched a new platform from scratch
  • Designed and delivered APIs, integrations, or event-driven systems at scale, not just maintained them, ideally in healthcare, veterinary tech, fintech, or SaaS
  • Led or technically directed other engineers, formally or as tech lead, and aligned multiple teams without formal authority
  • Daily hands-on use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, with the ability to explain how they change the way you design, build, and review

About the role:
PetDesk is looking for a Manager, Customer Success to lead the day-to-day execution of our Independent Customer Success team. The team serves clinics through two engagement models: a named CSM model for clinics that need a dedicated partner, and a pooled, digital-first model that supports clinics at scale.
The Director of Customer Success owns the frameworks and org-level strategy. This manager owns the execution layer: turning those frameworks into consistent team practice, coaching CSMs to measurable outcomes, and making sure no customer, escalation or save opportunity falls through the cracks.
Our customers are veterinary practices, not SaaS buyers, so the right approach often looks different from a traditional CS playbook. You'll help the team meet clinics where they are, whether that's a named CSM partnership or a scaled pooled experience.
description:
About the role:

PetDesk is looking for a Manager, Customer Success to lead the day-to-day execution of our Independent Customer Success team. The team serves clinics through two engagement models: a named CSM model for clinics that need a dedicated partner, and a pooled, digital-first model that supports clinics at scale.

The Director of Customer Success owns the frameworks and org-level strategy. This manager owns the execution layer: turning those frameworks into consistent team practice, coaching CSMs to measurable outcomes, and making sure no customer, escalation or save opportunity falls through the cracks.

Our customers are veterinary practices, not SaaS buyers, so the right approach often looks different from a traditional CS playbook. You'll help the team meet clinics where they are, whether that's a named CSM partnership or a scaled pooled experience.

lists.content:
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 7 CSMs across the named and pooled models through regular 1:1s, call and play reviews, performance feedback, goal setting and development plans

  • Hire, onboard and ramp new CSMs against clear 3, 6 and 12-month outcomes, and review performance profiles at least quarterly

  • Run both CS models day to day, making sure accounts sit in the right model and segment and move between models and CSMs with clean handoffs

  • Balance named books equitably across CSMs based on account complexity, volume and capacity, and plan PTO coverage so response-time targets hold

  • Monitor pooled queue health daily, including prioritization, response times, aging accounts and escalations, so nothing falls through the cracks

  • Make sure named CSMs deliver Success Plans and Business Reviews to standard, and pooled CSMs run ChurnZero plays and one-to-many programs (webinars, virtual office hours) consistently

  • Drive the Adoption milestone so new clinics graduate on time, and act on Launch CSAT, BR CSAT and NPS signals

  • Own the team's churn and downgrade results, with visibility into account health and churn risk and mitigation plans built before issues escalate

  • Serve as the team's escalation point, coaching CSMs through difficult customer situations and partnering with Support, Product and Implementation to resolve them

  • Coach the team to identify expansion opportunities and hand qualified opportunities to Sales

  • Report weekly to the Director, Customer Success on team activity, churn and downgrades, saves, loss opp pipeline, queue health, adoption and NRR

  • Drive consistent use of ChurnZero and Salesforce, and keep data accurate so reporting can be trusted

  • Continuously evaluate and improve plays, workflows and team practices based on customer and performance data, and surface recommendations to the Director

  • Travel up to 25% for customer onsites, industry events and team gatherings

• 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, with 2+ years managing or formally leading a team

  • Experience leading both high-touch (named book) and scaled or digital (pooled, one-to-many) Customer Success models

  • Proven record of reducing churn and downgrades, running save plays, and improving retention and NRR

  • Strong ability to coach to performance, set clear expectations and hold team members accountable to measurable outcomes while keeping trust high

  • Experience hiring, onboarding and ramping Customer Success team members

  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to use health scores, usage data and dashboards to prioritize team activity and spot risk early

  • Highly organized and process-minded, able to manage people, priorities and volume through systems and consistent operating rhythms

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting team performance and metrics to leadership

  • Comfortable facilitating group settings, including webinars, virtual office hours and Business Reviews

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Support, Implementation, Product and Sales

  • ChurnZero or comparable Customer Success platform experience required

  • Salesforce or similar CRM experience required; Guru or a similar knowledge base is a plus

  • Able to travel up to 25%

  • Veterinary industry experience is a plus

• The team meets or exceeds its targets for churn, downgrades, retention and NRR. Targets are set with the Director, Customer Success and tracked as part of this role's performance goals

  • Every cancellation and downgrade notice becomes a loss opp, and the team's save rate is measured against target and improves over time

  • On-time Adoption milestone completion is measured against target, and every new clinic has a Success Plan

  • Launch CSAT and BR CSAT are measured against target and stay at or above it

  • All 7 CSMs have clear expectations and consistent coaching, meet activity and Business Review targets, and new hires ramp on schedule

  • The pooled queue is consistently covered, with no aging accounts or missed response-time targets going unnoticed

  • Escalations are actively managed and are resolved, routed and documented promptly

  • Weekly reporting gives leadership a clear, accurate view of performance, risk and saves, backed by clean Salesforce and ChurnZero data

  • Expansion opportunities are consistently identified and handed off to Sales

  • Plays, workflows and team practices are regularly evaluated and improved based on performance and customer data

• Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80-90% covered by employer)

  • Employer HSA contribution with HDHP

  • 401(k) match up to 3.5% 

  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

  • Dental & Vision coverage available 

  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance

  • Short and Long Term Disability

  • Flexible Time Off & 12 Paid Annual Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support & Subsidized Pet Insurance

  • $250 Annual Stipend for Learning and Development

About the role:
PetDesk’s Support team handles thousands of conversations every month with veterinary clinics and pet parents, and the way we deliver that support is changing fast. This role exists to lead our frontline team through that change while keeping the experience customers rely on every day running smoothly. Your job is to coach and develop the team, help new hires ramp quickly, and set clear standards for quality. You will improve workflows and use AI to help customers get answers quickly, while ensuring team members spend their time where they add the most value. You will use data and customer insights to spot trends and pain points, and bring that voice of the customer to Support leadership and Product. You will work closely with these colleagues to ensure a consistent experience for every customer and pitch in wherever the team needs you.

lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and grow a frontline support team that helps veterinary clinics and pet parents succeed with our products
  • Onboard new team members and build consistent quality, confidence, and ownership across the team
  • Run daily support operations across every channel, keeping queues healthy and escalations moving
  • Rethink how support gets done, using automation, AI, and smarter workflows so more issues are fully resolved the first time, and customers can stay in channel and reach a person when they need one
  • Dig into support data and customer feedback to find trends, root causes (including repeat contacts and rework), and opportunities that make a real difference
  • Partner with Product and other teams to turn customer insights into better products and fewer repeat problems

  • Experience building or deploying customer-facing AI or chat experiences (such as virtual agents or support platform AI features) and surfacing the right knowledge for agents who support multiple products
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn support data and customer feedback into clear, practical improvements
  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to engage customers directly and influence cross-functional partners

About this Role:
PetDesk is looking for a contract Phones Support Specialist to give remote technical support to veterinary clinics that use its cloud VoIP phone system. The contractor will handle phone and ticket support, make system changes, and troubleshoot hardware and call routing problems so customers get fast, accurate help. 
This role's schedule is 12pm - 8 pm Eastern Time, Tuesday - Saturday. 
This is a 100% remote contract position, based in Latin America (including Central America), with availability aligned to North American business hours, as agreed per engagement.
Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required for this role. To apply for the Customer Support Specialist position, please submit your resume in English highlighting your qualifications. 
Contractors must provide their equipment (laptop, monitors, keyboard, mouse, etc.), stable internet connectivity, and dedicated workstations.

lists.content:
• Answer inbound support calls and work email tickets every shift, meeting first-reply and resolution targets.

  • Make system changes on the PBX, such as extensions, call routes, business hours, IVRs, ring groups and voicemail.

  • Troubleshoot and fix IP phone and hardware issues, including reboots, factory resets, provisioning and network checks.

  • Run remote diagnostics on call quality, registration and routing, and escalate to engineering or the carrier with clear notes when needed.

  • Set up and support system integrations for customers.

  • Write clear internal notes on every ticket and follow up until the issue is resolved.

  • At least 2 years of technical or customer support experience, ideally in VoIP, telecom or SaaS.

  • Working knowledge of VoIP and SIP basics, IP phones and basic networking (DHCP, DNS, switches, PoE).

  • Experience with a ticketing system such as Zendesk.

  • Strong customer service and conflict resolution skills, with empathy toward busy clinic staff.

  • Able to multitask on live calls, chats and tickets, prioritize urgent issues and manage time well.

  • Available Tuesday to Saturday during North American business hours.

lists.content:
• Lead the implementation process for PetDesk customers, work closely with customers to gather requirements, configure the software to their specific needs, and ensure a smooth and efficient onboarding experience

  • Use a customer success-based conversation approach that focuses on educating customers on how we can help improve processes and save time. Conduct comprehensive training sessions to educate customers on how to use PetDesk's software features and functionalities effectively

  • Understand each customer's unique requirements and challenges. Analyze and interpret results in our backend system to inform the customer, problem-solve through issues, and give an accurate and confident response

  • Develop strong relationships with customers by providing exceptional service and support throughout the implementation process; act as a trusted advisor, offering guidance and best practices to help them optimize their use of PetDesk's client communication software

  • Identify and resolve technical issues or challenges customers encounter during implementation. Collaborate with internal teams, including product support, Sales, and CS, to ensure timely resolution of issues and customer satisfaction.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions, implementation details, and configurations within our CRM.  Generate reports and provide insights on implementation progress, challenges, and successes to internal stakeholders.

  • Manage an onboarding pipeline which includes approximately 30-40 customers at any one time and undertake 3-4 customer calls a day.

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a customer-facing role, preferably in software implementation, customer success, or a related field, with primary customer communications over the phone or virtual meetings

  • Proficient in learning and understanding software applications quickly. Familiarity with client communication software, CRM systems, or SaaS solutions is advantageous

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport and trust with customers

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify and resolve customer issues effectively

  • Collaborative and able to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, and Customer Support, to deliver excellent customer outcomes

descriptionPlain:
About the role:
PetDesk’s Support team handles thousands of conversations every month with veterinary clinics and pet parents, and the way we deliver that support is changing fast. This role exists to lead that change while keeping the experience customers rely on every day running smoothly.
 
As Senior Manager of Support, you’ll lead a frontline team that helps clinics and pet parents get the most out of our products, and you’ll be accountable for the satisfaction, loyalty, and trust that support builds. Your job is to move us toward more complete, first-time resolutions with fewer repeat contacts and less rework by modernizing workflows, using automation and AI where they make sense (so customers get answers quickly and can still reach a person in the same channel), and making sure people step in where they add the most value.
 
You’ll use data and customer insights to spot trends and pain points, and you’ll bring that voice of the customer to Product and other partners to drive real improvements. You’ll also coach and develop the team so they’re equipped and motivated to do their best work. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys talking directly with customers and pitches in wherever the team needs it.

lists.content:

  • Talk directly with customers, earn their trust, and bring thoughtful solutions to their toughest challenges

• 7+ years of experience in customer support or customer experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience, including managing team leads or supervisors
  • Proven track record of improving customer outcomes such as CSAT, repeat contacts, and rework, while keeping resolution rate and response times healthy
  • Hands-on experience with support platforms such as Zendesk, including workflows, reporting, and automation
  • Experience building or deploying customer-facing AI or chat experiences (such as virtual agents or support platform AI features) and surfacing the right knowledge for agents who support multiple products
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn support data and customer feedback into clear, actionable improvements

About this role:
The company is expanding its data engineering capacity to support a growing product portfolio and rising analytical demand from internal teams and enterprise customers. This opening establishes senior technical leadership within the company's Sri Lanka-based engineering group, working in close partnership with the data team in the United States and elsewhere. description:
About this role:

The company is expanding its data engineering capacity to support a growing product portfolio and rising analytical demand from internal teams and enterprise customers. This opening establishes senior technical leadership within the company's Sri Lanka-based engineering group, working in close partnership with the data team in the United States and elsewhere. The Technical Lead is a hands-on individual contributor who owns technical direction for assigned workstreams, data modeling, pipeline architecture, and platform reliability, and raises the group's engineering standard through design and code reviews and mentorship.

lists.content:
• Leads technical design for assigned workstreams end-to-end, producing written design proposals for review before implementation begins.
  • Builds and maintains production models and pipelines in dbt Core, Snowflake SQL, and Python, remaining hands-on in the codebase most of the working week.
  • Investigates source data directly to derive modeling requirements and confirm grain and join logic where specifications are incomplete.
  • Reviews pull requests daily, enforcing modeling conventions, test coverage, and performance standards.
  • Owns reliability of assigned pipelines, diagnosing failures and implementing tests and alerting that catch data issues before stakeholders do.
  • Mentors engineers through pairing and design feedback, growing local ownership of the platform over time.
  • Coordinates daily with engineers and stakeholders across regions, translating ambiguous business questions into scoped work.

• 8+ years in data or software engineering, including 2+ years as a technical lead, architect, or owner of a major data platform workstream.
  • Expert SQL, including analytical functions and performance tuning in a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Deep production dbt experience (Core preferred): multi-repo project structure, testing strategy, macros, incremental models, CI integration.
  • Strong Python for pipeline code, API integrations, and orchestration in Airflow or equivalent.
  • Proven ability to work from raw, undocumented source systems and propose a defensible model without being handed requirements.
  • Working knowledge of ingestion tooling (Airbyte, Fivetran, or similar), CDC patterns, and relational sources such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
  • Git-based workflows, CI/CD (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or similar), and scripting or IaC on AWS.
  • Track record of raising team engineering standards in ways that outlasted a single project.
  • Clear written and spoken English; documents decisions well and disagrees constructively in review.
  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; makes progress and escalates appropriately when other team members are offline.
